curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Name the three exam parts, then match each kind of applicant to the tests they take.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on the exam parts, where tests are given and each applicant's test set.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions on which tests an applicant must take.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the vision standard, then the knowledge test's content, formats, accommodations and online option.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on the vision standard and knowledge test formats and rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on the vision screening and knowledge test options.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Contrast the waiting periods after a failure and after cheating, and list conduct rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on retake waits, fees, documents and cheating.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on retakes, waits and test conduct.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through booking, arriving, weather limits and who may ride along on the road test.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on appointments, arrival, documents, weather and passengers.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions on road test logistics.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Check the road test vehicle part by part: belts, brakes, lights, wipers, mirrors, tint and bumpers.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on each vehicle equipment requirement.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on whether a vehicle meets road test requirements.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain what the examiner watches, what causes immediate failure, and how errors set the retest wait.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on scoring areas, automatic failures and error bands.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on road test scoring and retest waits.
